title: Add Scroll By Row option
line: The Pager has a new "Scroll column by column" option, so scrolling over a 2x4 grid goes 1, 5, 2, 6, 3, 7, 4, 8.
explanation: The Pager's wheel handler always stepped to the previous or next desktop number, so in a grid it went through a whole row before moving to the next one, with no way to go down the columns first. The change adds a "Scroll column by column" checkbox to the Pager settings; when it is on, the wheel walks the grid as it is laid out on screen column by column, still honouring "Navigation wraps around" and the no-Show-Desktop rule at the ends.

commits.message:
applets/pager: add an option to scroll column by column

Scrolling over the pager always followed the desktop numbers, going
through a whole row before the next one. A new "Scroll column by column"
option makes the wheel go down each column of the grid first instead.

BUG: 525164

media.caption: Master, 8 desktops in 2 rows: each scroll step over the Pager goes 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8.
With "Scroll column by column" on, the same steps go 1, 5, 2, 6, 3, 7, 4, 8.
Pager settings on master: no scrolling option.
Pager settings with the new "Scroll column by column" checkbox.
